page.content:
Last child of Hadley's Hope.

How Newt connects

  • Work: Aliens — Newt is the child survivor at the center of Aliens.
  • Character: Ellen Ripley — Ripley becomes Newt's protector on LV-426.
  • Location: LV-426 — Newt is a child of the LV-426 colony.

What is Newt?

Newt is the colony child who survived in the vents of Hadley's Hope and becomes the civilian Ripley will not abandon.

Key threads lead to Aliens, Ellen Ripley and LV-426.
